name: zinterp_context_clear_var_table
description: zInterp_Context::ClearVarTable frees owned variable names, frees the table, and clears the variable table state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c16c0 validates freeing each varTable entry name, leaving value pointers untouched, freeing the table when non-null, then clearing varTable and varCount.
The native smoke verifies populated and empty clear paths leave the variable table pointer null and count zero while caller-owned values remain unchanged.
